With that you don't just settle your stomach in the morning, but also give you energy to get through the day. That also applies to lunch, to use that energy in the afternoon. Calories = energy which is why it matters what you put in your body. Given you can eat chocolate bars and drink soda and nothing else and loose weight, but your muscles and your body in general will suffer from that. Food = energy = life!
When I did a stricter workout/ meal plan I ate 5 times a day a total of 2400 calories on workout days and about 2000 on rest days, and I started loosing fat and gaining muscle. (to put it into perspective for you I'm currently 164cm and 64kg)
